annotations.title: Run one action over many inputs

description: Run one action over many inputs in one call (1 to 100 items, each the action's inputs), such as a company lookup for 20 domains. Priced the same per item as a single run, with no fee for batching, and only delivered results are charged; max_cost_usd caps the whole batch. Price one item with capability_inspect first and tell the person the total before running. The answer comes within about 45 seconds with each item's state, rows and charge; an item with rows has results_page and csv_url: give the person those links instead of writing the rows out again; items not finished by then finish when the same call is sent again (nothing runs or is charged twice). NOT for: one run, which is run_capability, or a ready-made job, which is run_recipe.

id.description: An action id or tool id from capability_search or capability_inspect. One action for the whole batch.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: your own key for this batch, 8 to 200 letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens. The same key and item answers the same run with no new charge; a new key runs it again. Left out, the same call the same UTC day is the same batch.

items.description: 1 to 100 objects, each the action's inputs for one run, by name, as run_capability's arguments.

max_cost_usd.description: Optional: the most the whole batch may cost, in USD, such as "2.50". Without it the workspace's normal limits apply.

max_items.description: Most rows each item collects, 1-100. Default 10.

tag.description: Optional: a label for every run in this batch, such as the customer or project it is for: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Activity shows runs and cost by tag. It stays in Ahel and is never sent to a provider.
